turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why did the zero go in before anyone called me?
Then answer me. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to first?
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.
Late assignments from September aren't an integrity matter, and that's a threat, not evidence. I'll be telling the principal you made it. Now, who decided on the zero?
Then I'll make it simpler. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in, yes or no?
